body: Worker trap (Termal::Opus3, 2026-10-27 01:24Z; my own slip on w-919a). Coordinators also throttle NODE-only checks (tsc, vitest) during another project's full gate. Fable2 #3715 held vitest until 01:42Z because it is CPU-heavy. The hold arrived while my turn was busy, and I launched vitest without re-reading the mailbox; it ran 46 s inside Engram's gate. Rule: before ANY test launch, including node-only tsc and vitest that need no build slot, re-read the coordinator mailbox in the same turn and honour every hold window. "Node-only, no slot needed" does not mean "free to run any time".
